'''Ptellung''' was a [[Ssi-ruu]] scientist during the [[Battle of G'rho]]. After luring the young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dev Sibwarra]] aboard a [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium|Ssi-ruuvi]] ship, [[Th'twirirl]] brought him to Ptellung's laboratory to be stripped, measured, and probed. When Ptellung was done studying the boy, Th'twirirl gave the Human to [[Yifaii]].
